summary: Feed s099_single to APM is degraded due to 9.9% duplicate packets (209/2117) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, VLAN, truncation, drops, overload, tunnels, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Duplicate packets from overlapping capture points (e.g., SPAN sessions or dual TAP feeds) aggregated to a single tool port without packet broker deduplication. Same packet seen via two paths and forwarded twice.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions, inflate flow counts and distort latency/response-time calculations, wasting processing and potentially triggering false performance alerts despite not needing full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet broker deduplication to suppress identical packets arriving within a short window before delivery to the 10G APM port, restoring accurate transaction counts without losing coverage.
